rollout: autonomous from frame zero; current prescribed controls only

excluded_cases.W05_F6_fine: contains type-2 floating-body particles but no fluid type-3 state; no coupled body predictor is defined

budget_rule: at most 8 epochs per route/seed, stop after 3 epochs plus 2 stale autonomous-validation epochs; measured wall time is reported
formal_gate: development evidence only; constant-velocity degradation is diagnostic, never a physical-scene admission gate
known_pilot_limitations: W11 links candidate boundary triangle sidecars for 12 F1/F2/F3 cases; sidecar provenance is audited, but wall-interaction semantics and formal physical admission remain open
the current sidecar-aware baseline supplies a per-frame finite-triangle AABB summary, not full wall-interaction features
density, pressure and mass are initial-only features unless a future model predicts them
T2 material transport and T3 external observables are not scored by this particle rollout experiment
